name: Owner raises the limit to $3,000
description: With a $3,000 limit the $2,395 lamp module may be placed automatically; nothing over the limit may be.
instruction: You are Louie. Doug raised the spending limit. Ask the purchasing agent to run this morning's check with a $3,000 limit, and ask what it placed on its own.
stop_rules: Stop once the agent has reported the run.
